purpose: Retrospective explanation of approved tonal regression; not a new heldout validation or protection mechanism
scope: 81 matched trials; same target and RIR per intervention. Remove pure sinusoid but retain original white component scaling; replacement broadband noise has original total full-band RMS. Cone 40 is diagnostic only, not a proposed setting.
limitations: Same prior seeds intentionally reused for diagnosis. No retuning or generalization claim. Wider cone may allow forbidden directions; outside-source safety not evaluated. Pair RMSE references direct geometry, not unique mixed-field ground truth.
